# Tableau Workbook & Build Spec

## Files
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `revenue_intelligence.twbx` | Packaged workbook (workbook + data extract). Open this in Tableau Desktop or Tableau Public. |
| `revenue_intelligence.twb` | Same workbook, unpackaged. Reads `../../data/processed/tableau_extract.csv`, so keep the repo folder layout. |
| `calculated_fields.md` | Field/format rules. |
| `dashboard_audit.md` | QA checklist and spot-check values. |

**How these were made:** the workbook XML was generated by a script, not
saved from Tableau, and it has not been verified in Tableau Desktop. On
first open, check every sheet against `dashboard_audit.md`. If Tableau
reports an error or a sheet looks wrong, rebuild that sheet from the spec
below. After it opens cleanly, re-save from Tableau so the file is a
native Tableau save.

The rest of this document is the field-by-field spec the workbook follows.

## 1. Connect

Data source → Text File → `data/processed/tableau_extract.csv` (same numbers plus helper columns; see `calculated_fields.md`). Audit an existing workbook with `dashboard_audit.md`.
Set `sales_month` to Date type on import (it is already `YYYY-MM-DD` in
the CSV).

## 2. KPI Cards (top row)

| Card | Field / Calculation |
|---|---|
| Total Revenue | `SUM([current_month_revenue])` |
| Latest MoM Growth % | Last value of `[mom_growth_pct]` by `MAX([sales_month])` |
| Latest Month Revenue | Last value of `[current_month_revenue]` by `MAX([sales_month])` |

Format all currency fields with no decimal places; format the growth %
card with a conditional color (green if ≥ 0, red if < 0).

## 3. Main visual — Monthly Revenue Trend

- Chart type: Line
- X-axis: `sales_month` (continuous, month granularity)
- Y-axis: `current_month_revenue`
- Add a second line: `rolling_3m_avg`, dashed, secondary color
- Reference: none needed — the rolling average line serves as the trend
  reference already in the data.

## 4. Secondary visual — MoM Growth %

- Chart type: Bar
- X-axis: `sales_month`
- Y-axis: `mom_growth_pct`
- Color: diverging (green ≥ 0, red < 0) — use a calculated field
  `IF [mom_growth_pct] >= 0 THEN "Growth" ELSE "Decline" END` on the Color
  shelf if a two-color palette is preferred over a continuous diverging
  scale.
- The first month (`mom_growth_pct` is null) will correctly render with
  no bar — do not replace the null with 0.

## 5. Diagnostic — Revenue vs. Rolling 3-Month Average

- Chart type: Line/area combo
- Plot `current_month_revenue` and `rolling_3m_avg` on the same axis
- Optionally shade the area between them to visually flag
  above-trend/below-trend months (this mirrors
  `vs_rolling_trend` in `sql/03_analysis/05_growth_diagnostics.sql`)

## 6. Recent Performance — Last 3 vs. Previous 3 Months

- Chart type: Bar (2 bars)
- Use a calculated field bucketing `sales_month` into "Last 3 Months" /
  "Previous 3 Months" / null (exclude null from the view), matching the
  logic in `sql/04_business_cases/04_recent_performance.sql`
- Y-axis: `AVG([current_month_revenue])`

## What is intentionally NOT on this dashboard

Orders count, Order Growth %, AOV, and any "revenue driven by volume vs.
value" panel — the source data has no order-level information. See
`docs/assumptions.md`.

## After building

1. Export a screenshot to `dashboard/dashboard-preview.png` (replacing the
   static preview) and to `assets/dashboard-preview.png`.
2. Save the workbook as `dashboard/tableau/revenue_intelligence.twbx`
   (packaged workbook, so the CSV extract travels with it).
